title: Part Twelve: Does Iran Want War With America?

sections.brief: The case that Iran has avoided direct war with the US: the 2003 Swiss fax (authority contested, both sides); JCPOA 2013-15; Vienna 2021-22; the 2025 Oman rounds and the cancelled sixth; February 2026 Muscat/Geneva talks two days before the strikes; Ain al-Asad 2020 (warning via Baghdad, no deaths, 110 TBI) and Al Udeid 2025 (notice, Trump's thanks); Khamenei 2019 and Zarif 2020 statements; forward-defence doctrine read by Barzegar, Vaez, and Clawson's opposing view. Figures: time

The case against: Beirut 1983 (Peterson findings, denials); Iraq 603 deaths (US claim, report unreleased); Dec 2019 contractor; Tower 22; hostages 1979-81 and the 2023 swap; Arbabsiar, Bolton and Shakeri/Trump plots; 2019 tankers and Abqaiq (UN panel, Iran's denial); 2026 lethal strikes on US bases; 'Death to America' and Khamenei's gloss. Synthesis: avoidance of all-out war is supported, absence of hostility is not; motive is argument; the 'dragged in' question goes to Part 14. Figures: compare
